description: The Histograms.java file defines a utility class for gathering, processing, and reporting statistical data within the software. It includes internal data structures for managing histograms, statistics groups, and individual statistics, as well as methods for adding data, snapshotting, merging, and formatting output for logging. Its functionality focuses on performance measurement, confidence interval calculations, and detailed statistical reporting.

classes.name: Histograms
classes.description: Main class that manages statistical data collection, histograms, and reporting

classes.name: Histograms.LocalStats
classes.description: Internal class representing thread-local statistical data

classes.name: Histograms.Statistics
classes.description: Represents statistical data for a single operation or metric, including counts and histogram data

classes.name: Histograms.StatisticsGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of statistics of the same type

classes.name: Histograms.ValueType
classes.description: Enum defining different value types, currently only 'INVOCATION' is defined

methods.name: dumpStats
methods.description: Generates a summarized report of all collected statistics and resets the snapshot

methods.name: getCurrentStatistics
methods.description: Returns a report of current statistics without altering internal state

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a sample value to the statistics for a given type and name

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the histogram index for a given value

methods.name: sortStatistics
methods.description: Sorts statistics within a group for reporting purposes

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a double value into a string buffer with appropriate precision

methods.name: appendHeader
methods.description: Appends a header line for a statistics group into a string buffer

methods.name: appendStatistics
methods.description: Appends detailed statistics data for a specific group into a string buffer

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a statistics group into a formatted string for logging

methods.name: getCurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Returns current snapshots of accumulated statistics without resetting

methods.name: takeAndResetSnapshot
methods.description: Returns current snapshots of accumulated statistics and clears stored data

methods.name: mergeStats
methods.description: Merges statistics from source into a snapshot map

methods.name: getLocalStats
methods.description: Returns thread-local statistics, optionally resetting after retrieval
